decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (5723 02 received 25.09.12;  5723 03A received 23 November 2012; and 5723 01A received 19.10.12.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - Two marked customer parking bays shall be provided on site before the use hereby approved commences and shall be permanently available for that purpose only thereafter.

Condition : 5 - No activity shall take place on site earlier than 9am or later than 6pm Monday to Friday and no earlier than 9am or later than 2pm on Saturday and not at all on Sundays and public holidays.
Condition : 6 - No works to vehicles shall be carried out other than within the building on the site

Condition : 7 - The parking spaces shown on the drawing hereby approved (5723 03A received 23 November 2012) shall be kept available for the use of vehicles brought to the site for servicing testing and repairs or for staff parking and used for no other purpose
Condition : 8 - Refuse generated on the site shall be stored on site prior to collection and only in the location marked on the approved plan 5723 03A received 23 November 2012.
description: Change of use of existing car repair garage to an MOT servicing bay with installation of additional roller shutter door to the front elevation
